summary: A fixed-size server billed by the hour but never more than its monthly price, from creation until deletion; a powered-off server costs the same as a running one.

egress.included: 20 TB per month in the EU network zone, 1 TB in the US, 0.5 TB in Singapore
egress.note: $1.20 per extra TB in the EU and US and $8.30 per extra TB in Singapore, billed in 100 MB blocks (Hetzner's price API, products CLOUD_66 and the plan pages). Incoming and internal traffic is free.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: No plan and no fee: each server is billed from creation until deletion, at the hourly rate up to its own monthly cap.

notes: These are Hetzner's own USD prices for the EU network zone (Falkenstein, Nuremberg, Helsinki), read from the price API the plan pages use. US and Singapore plans are priced separately and higher.
A public IPv4 is billed separately at $0.60 a month or $0.001 an hour per server, and the calculator includes it. A server with only an IPv6 address (free) costs $0.60 a month less.
Each server's usage is rounded up to a whole hour, so a ten-minute task on its own server bills a full hour. The calculator rounds each task up the same way.
A powered-off server is billed in full until it is deleted: there is no pause, sleep or cheaper stopped-storage rate. billedWhileStopped applies the running hourly rate to stopped hours.
The bill is capped at each server's monthly price, which binds at about 624 hours at these rates. shape.monthly applies that cap to machines mode.

Snapshots, backups, volumes, Floating IPs and load balancers are separate products and are not priced by this card. Hetzner no longer publishes a snapshot rate on its live pricing pages: the API exposes an image price per GB-month (and a 20% backup surcharge) but needs a token to read, and the last figure visible on a legacy page variant was €0.011/$0.0130 per GB-month, unverified today.

Out of stock: the cheaper Cost-Optimized plans are listed at CX23 2 vCPU / 4 GB / 40 GB €5.99; CAX11 (Arm) 2 / 4 / 40 €6.49; CX33 4 / 8 / 80 €8.99; CAX21 (Arm) 4 / 8 / 80 €10.99; CX43 8 / 16 / 160 €16.49; CAX31 (Arm) 8 / 16 / 160 €21.49; CX53 16 / 32 / 320 €29.99; CAX41 (Arm) 16 / 32 / 320 €41.49 a month (EU prices before VAT and the separate IPv4 charge), but every one is marked 'not available' with 'This product is currently unavailable. Please check back later.' (checked 30 October 2026). They are not priced by the calculator until Hetzner sells them again; when it does, a 2 vCPU / 4 GB server costs about a third of the CPX22 used here.

cpuSharing.label: Shared CPU
cpuSharing.detail: The CPX plans priced here share physical cores with the other servers on the same host; dedicated-core CCX plans cost more.

source.quote: In plans (CX, CPX, CAX) with shared resources the compute resources are distributed among all instances on the same physical server.

upkeep.label: You run the server
upkeep.detail: Hetzner's terms make managing and securing the server, and keeping backups, your job. Firewalls are free; Hetzner's daily backups are paid and off until you switch them on.

source.quote: The Customer is responsible for managing and securing these products at their own expense and risk.
